name: Rizuhble's Flat-Pack Fort McGinnis
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out of lane. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-10,400 (levels 1-17). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Mini Turret T3, Heavy Barrage unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown, vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery. Ultimate (Heavy Barrage) is available from Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Spirit Burn later. Until then it speeds up camps: +25% weapon damage and +25% bullet resist against non-hero targets.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Mini Turret (1 to 2).

items.name: Mystic Slow
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Mini Turret: widens its range (turret attack falloff end, turret attack falloff start).
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Mini Turret: takes 18% off its 18s base cooldown.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 10,400-21,600 (levels 17-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Spectral Wall T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Spectral Wall, damage) grows from 101 to 142.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 13.2 to Spectral Wall's damage (0.73x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Mini Turret (4 to 5). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 278s; 20% off is 55.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-42,400 (levels 27-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Medicinal Specter T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Spectral Wall, damage) grows from 142 to 206.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 15,200 to 20,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Heavy Barrage min distance (8.5m), Heavy Barrage explosion radius (4.5m), Mini Turret turret attack range (40m). Takes spirit from 20,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 21.9 to Spectral Wall's damage (0.73x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healbane.
sections.desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healbane.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They dive you and you've got no way out.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep you from getting away.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep catching you before you can get away.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review
items.legacy_note: Instead of Healbane when your team has gun heroes.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Heavy Barrage deals damage (damage per rocket), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Upgrade of Mystic Slow (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Heavy Barrage duration (14s), Heavy Barrage move slow duration (1s), Mini Turret turret lifetime (47s). Replaces Healbane: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Turrets last longer, so more are up at once. Sell Healbane for this.

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Mini Turret: resets its 18s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Stamina Mastery: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On the turret. Sell Stamina Mastery for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 233s of base cooldown across your kit, 155s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Radiant Regeneration: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
